text:
viv (PM): Posted the postmortem for yesterday's serving hiccup: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/1849999999-serving-hiccup-postmortem. TL;DR: unexpected KV cache invalidation + a mis-tuned autoscaler strategy caused a 20m window of elevated p95/p99 and a small set of 5xxs.
raj (SRE): Reading now. I added the timeline and noted a correlation between cache eviction burst and a surge of small-seq requests.
claire (Eng): I captured a repro in staging and linked a short runbook PR with steps to limit kernel-level swap churn.
tom (Support): Customer comms draft is in the doc under "communications"; we've notified impacted customers and scheduled follow-ups.
viv (PM): Main follow-ups (owner -> due): 1) reduce autoscaler burst cap -> @raj (due 2026-04-06). 2) create cache soft-eviction alert + dashboard -> @claire (due 2026-04-09). 3) add short-sequence perf smoke to CI -> @maya (QA) (due 2026-04-08). 4) update runbook with failover steps -> @raj (due 2026-04-05).
raj (SRE): Ack. I'll push the runbook change and start the autoscaler test in staging today.
claire (Eng): I'll own the dashboards and add a quick test harness for cache churn scenarios.
ops-bot: Postmortem published by viv (PM)  https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/1849999999-serving-hiccup-postmortem (automated).
viv (PM): Setting a 30m follow-up review to close action items: Wed 2026-04-07 09:00 PT. Invite sent. If you can't make it, drop updates in the doc and react with :white_check_mark:.
tom (Support): We'll hold off final customer note until after the Wed sync.
viv (PM): Please add progress checks in the owners table. I'll triage any blockers tomorrow.
_meta: postmortem announcement: published link, TL;DR, action items with owners and dates, follow-up sync scheduling. Unique wording and filename.
